s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic scalp lesions with disseminated erythematous papules and petechial hemorrhages
salient_findings: Nonhealing crusted scalp lesions for 3 years
Multiple disseminated erythematous papules and petechial hemorrhages on the scalp
Yellowish crusts on the scalp
Osteolytic lesions on the right frontoparietal skull
Subepidermal infiltrate with large cells and kidney-shaped nuclei on biopsy
key_facts: 4-year-old boy
3-year history of nonhealing crusted scalp lesions
Previous treatments with topical glucocorticosteroids and antibiotics showed no improvement
Occasional otitis media
Negative family history for skin disease
Multiple disseminated erythematous papules and petechial hemorrhages on the scalp
Yellowish crusts on the scalp
Normal routine blood examinations
Osteolytic lesions on the right frontoparietal skull on whole-body MRI
Subepidermal infiltrate with large cells and kidney-shaped nuclei on punch biopsy of scalp
Infiltrate stained positively for CD1A on immunohistochemical staining
Normal ultrasonography of abdomen and lymph nodes
Normal serum electrophoresis

shortlist.label: Langerhans cell histiocytosis
shortlist.why_kept: Positive CD1A staining and presence of osteolytic lesions are characteristic of this disease

shortlist.label: Langerhans cell sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Aggressive nature of the disease and presence of kidney-shaped nuclei in the infiltrate make it a plausible diagnosis

shortlist.label: Non-Langerhans cell histiocytosis
shortlist.why_kept: Subepidermal infiltrate with large cells and absence of Langerhans cell specific markers make it a possible diagnosis

shortlist.label: Erdheim-Chester disease
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of osteolytic lesions and histiocytic infiltrate are consistent with this rare disease

shortlist.label: Rosai-Dorfman disease
shortlist.why_kept: Emperipolesis and presence of histiocytes with kidney-shaped nuclei are characteristic features of this disease

raw.rationale: The presence of subepidermal infiltrate with large cells and kidney-shaped nuclei, along with positive CD1A staining on immunohistochemical staining, is consistent with Langerhans cell histiocytosis.

rejected.label: Langerhans cell sarcoma
rejected.why: No evidence of sarcomatous features in the biopsy results.

rejected.label: Non-Langerhans cell histiocytosis
rejected.why: CD1A positivity is specific to Langerhans cell histiocytosis.

rejected.label: Erdheim-Chester disease
rejected.why: Typically involves foamy histiocytes and has a distinct clinical presentation.

rejected.label: Rosai-Dorfman disease
rejected.why: Characterized by emperipolesis and typically involves lymph nodes.
